newsitem.title: USA: Penn Traffic Q3 same-store sales, revs down.
newsitem.headline: Penn Traffic Q3 same-store sales, revs down.

text.p: Penn Traffic Co said Tuesday that revenues for the third quarter ended November 2, 1996 were about $811 million, down four percent from the prior year, and same-store sales decreased 1.9 percent for the quarter.

In a release Tuesday the company said year-to-date same store sales were down 2.1 percent from the prior year and year-to-date revenues were about $2.482 billion, a decrease of 4.2 percent from the prior year.
It added that prior year revenues include $12.5 million generated by 11 of the company's former general merchandise stores which were closed after the third quarter of 1996.
Excluding these closed stores, revenues for the third quarter decreased by 2.5 percent, Penn Traffic said.
Penn Traffic said it expects to report its third quarter financial results on December 3, 1996.
